page_title: AST 3-3 BRE | Aston Villa v Brentford 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+7' Michael Salisbury shows the yellow card to Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) for a heavy challenge.
90+7' Dangerous play by Alex Moreno (Aston Villa). Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Youri Tielemans is given a rest as he is replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
90+1' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) will replace Leon Bailey.
90+1' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) replacing Lucas Digne.
90+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' The substitution is prepared. Frank Onyeka (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mathias Jensen.
86' Thomas Frank has decided to substitute Bryan Mbeumo and he is replaced by Neal Maupay (Brentford).
84' A yellow card for a tackle by Diego Carlos (Aston Villa). Michael Salisbury doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
81' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Yoane Wissa will be replaced by Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford).
81' The referee signals a substitution. Ivan Toney (Brentford) is brought on as a substitute for Mikkel Damsgaard.
80' 3 - 3 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) heads the ball inside the left post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
79' The linesman signals that Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
76' Here is a change. Sergio Reguilon is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
76' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Salisbury has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) comes onto the pitch so that Morgan Rogers can be given a rest.
68' 2 - 3 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
67' Brentford take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Brentford can continue in their attacking effort.
65' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Brentford have a corner.
61' 2 - 2 Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) converts a killer cross with a curling shot inside the left post! What a perfect finish!
59' 2 - 1 Zanka (Brentford) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
58' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Michael Salisbury didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
51' Michael Salisbury has a clear sight and sees a foul from Pau Torres (Aston Villa).
50' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
46' 2 - 0 Goal! Youri Tielemans provides Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a precise effort inside the right post. 2:0.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A corner kick by Aston Villa is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Aston Villa.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Aston Villa work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' Aston Villa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
42' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Michael Salisbury ignores the protests.
38' 1 - 0 Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) heads the ball inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
38' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
36' A clumsy foul by Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle.
34' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and it's Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Aston Villa.
29' A poorly taken free kick by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
29' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) brought his opponent down. Aston Villa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
28' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
25' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
25' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Aston Villa get a corner.
23' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
19' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Salisbury no option but to blow his whistle.
17' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
12' Aston Villa fail to score from a corner as Mark Flekken (Brentford) leaps to collect the ball.
12' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman points to the corner flag, Aston Villa are going to take it.
11' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
8' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is caught offside!
6' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the right post. What a chance!
5' Poor challenge! Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brentford.
3' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
2' One of the Brentford players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
2' What a huge chance for Sergio Reguilon (Brentford). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Brentford will kick the game off.
Michael Salisbury is introduced as the referee for today's match.
